name: Air from space (Sentinel-5P)
summary: Satellite readings of nitrogen dioxide, carbon monoxide, ozone, sulphur dioxide and a dust-and-smoke signal over each city, once a day when the sky is clear. Needs a free account.

el.name: Ο αέρας από το διάστημα (Sentinel-5P)
el.summary: Δορυφορικές μετρήσεις διοξειδίου του αζώτου, μονοξειδίου του άνθρακα, όζοντος, διοξειδίου του θείου και ένδειξης σκόνης και καπνού πάνω από κάθε πόλη, μία φορά την ημέρα όταν ο ουρανός είναι καθαρός. Χρειάζεται δωρεάν λογαριασμό.

publisher.name: ESA and the European Commission (Copernicus Sentinel-5P), via the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem

licence.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2026 (Sentinel-5P TROPOMI), accessed through the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem

restrictions: Needs a free Copernicus Data Space account and an OAuth client (client id and secret)
A free account has quotas (see the CDSE Quotas page); we ask about 20 small requests every 6 hours
This data collection allows only one band per request

update.note: One pass a day over Cyprus (about 13:30 local solar time); the feed asks every 6 hours.

variables.note: Tropospheric NO2, whole column from the ground up.
Total ozone column, the thickness of the ozone layer.
Sulphur dioxide, whole column. Near zero is noise.
Band AER_AI_340_380. Positive: dust or smoke high in the air.

quality.uncertainty: A mean of the clear pixels in an area about 18 km wide, once a day. A column is all the air from the ground to space, not the air at the school. Clouds hide the air below.
known_issues: Only where the sky is clear enough: on cloudy days a city has no value, sometimes for several days.
One pass a day around 13:30 local solar time: it cannot show the morning or the evening rush hour.
NO2 and SO2 columns are not street-level amounts. Most CO is high in the air and may come from far away.
The UV aerosol index is a signal (above about 1 hints at dust or smoke), not a measured amount. Clouds can disturb it.
SO2 near zero can be slightly negative: instrument noise, not real.

use_for: Telling a Saharan dust or smoke day: a clearly positive UV aerosol index
Seeing if NO2 over a whole city area is higher than usual
Showing students what a satellite can and cannot see
not_for: Street-level NO2 or what a pupil breathes at school
Hourly changes or the rush hour
Cloudy days: no value does not mean no pollution

notes: Not active until CDSE_CLIENT_SECRET and CDSE_CLIENT_ID are set on the server (free: create an OAuth client in the Copernicus Data Space account settings). The reader follows the Sentinel Hub Statistical API documentation and is not yet tested against the live service.
